==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Due to his heavy mana-spending style, he has said that the [[Mana Potion]] is his favorite item.
* Prior to playing League of Legends, he played DOTA for team Masta.
* Shares the exact last name and middle name with [[Lovida]], although no relationship between the two has been confirmed yet.
